title: Command Pallette Dock Perf Mon Spacing
author: coryladams
summary: Command Palette Dock compact mode reserves excessive horizontal space for changing Performance Monitor values, while hiding titles also hides the values.

confidence.rationale: The screenshot strongly localizes the symptom to item measurement/presentation, but the exact template property introduced by the preview update still needs code inspection.

judgment.rationale: The current preview report includes a screenshot, exact compact-mode configuration, and a clear regression after an update. The layout can be investigated without asking the reporter to restate the behavior.
evidence: PowerToys preview 0.101.2522 shows large stable gaps between Performance Monitor dock items in compact mode.
The attached screenshot shows the values rendered inside much wider item slots than their visible content.
Turning titles off removes the values but leaves the icons, so value visibility and title presentation appear coupled.
judgment.recommended_action: Inspect the Dock item measurement and Performance Monitor title/value presentation, then validate a bounded stable width in compact mode.

fix_assessment.rationale: No active merged fix covers the scoped PowerToys-owned path. The visual regression is concrete. A safe fix should preserve stable widths for changing metrics while separating value visibility from optional title text and avoiding per-update layout movement.

proposed_fixes.title: Bound compact Performance Monitor item width without hiding values
proposed_fixes.root_cause: The Dock item template or Performance Monitor band appears to reserve a broad stable title/value width for dynamic metrics, and the value is coupled to the title-visibility setting.
plan: Locate the Command Palette Dock compact item template and Performance Monitor band presentation properties.
Separate metric-value visibility from the optional title flag and replace the excessive fixed/minimum width with a content-bounded stable width.
Add visual or view-model coverage for compact metrics with short and long values and for titles enabled/disabled.
verification: Open the Performance Monitor band in compact Dock mode and confirm adjacent items remain stable without the reported large gaps.
Disable titles and confirm the metric values remain available according to the intended compact-mode design.

confidence.rationale: The screenshot strongly localizes the symptom to item measurement/presentation, but the exact template property introduced by the preview update still needs code inspection.

issue_context.summary: Command Palette Dock compact mode reserves excessive horizontal space for changing Performance Monitor values, while hiding titles also hides the values.
known_information: The issue reproduces on preview build 0.101.2522 after an update.
The Dock is configured in compact mode.
The reporter supplied a screenshot and Windows 11 build 26200.9278.
inferences: A newly introduced fixed or minimum width likely prevents value jitter but is larger than needed for the formatted values.
The value may be flowing through the title field, explaining why disabling titles removes it.
issue_context.analysis: The visual regression is concrete. A safe fix should preserve stable widths for changing metrics while separating value visibility from optional title text and avoiding per-update layout movement.
initial_investigation: Read the complete report, labels, and screenshot markup; no comments, assignee, or linked fix are present.
Compared the two reported settings outcomes: compact mode creates excessive reserved width, and hiding titles removes metric values.

reproduce.title: Compare Performance Monitor item widths in compact Dock mode
reproduce.version_requirement: Current stable PowerToys release unless the issue names a required preview build
prerequisites: PowerToys preview 0.101.2522 or a current build containing the same Dock update
Performance Monitor pinned to the Dock
setup: Set the Dock to compact mode and enable titles.
Pin multiple changing Performance Monitor values next to each other.
steps: Observe the gaps while values update.
Turn titles off and record whether values disappear.
Compare measured item widths with the longest visible value.
reproduce.expected_result: Changing metrics should remain readable and visually stable without excessive empty space; title visibility should not unintentionally remove required values.
